rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded Day 5 blastocyst with large blastocoel and thinned zona appropriately, and cautiously notes limited visibility of ICM/TE on a single static image. Minor overinterpretation of image-based TE/ICM detail prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF failures, unexplained infertility, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, especially around balancing strong embryo morphology against prior failed cycles. Minor issues include slightly imprecise wording around endometrial thickness and some speculative explanations.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including support for single embryo transfer and cautious use of add-ons. Small deviations include speculative endorsement of freeze-all/FET and sperm DNA fragmentation testing without stronger indication.
Provides practical, case-relevant recommendations for current transfer management and structured future workup if unsuccessful, with appropriate nuance and specific next steps.
